release_history.summary: First real, install-succeeding Release-Contract-compliant Release for this application (revised from an original "1.2.0" candidate that correctly failed at real install time -- see source.git_commit and Pass 5's own Phase 2 record for the two real bugs found and fixed: a stale configuration-template path left over from construction, and a Platform config-render path mismatch, both fixed before this version was cut). Hand-constructed from this repository's own pre-existing release/1.2.0 tooling (not built via the shared RAH Packaging Engine), reusing its real content per Pass 5's own construction plan.
